prior_refutation_preserved: ZERO_EDGE_INVARIANT_RESULT.json refutes equality of the full zero-credit edge forests. Its same-owner edge is a genuine counterexample; the old predicate is not rewritten.
candidate: Every physical directed A/B edge whose two owner banks are zero and different is present in A exactly when present in B. Differences internal to one physical block are unconstrained.
reason: A reset preserves this cross-edge property for the same footprint reason. If it held, disagreements could still live inside bounded five-key blocks; a separate bounded internal-debt proof would be necessary before inferring funding.
not_a_quotient: No identification of block vertices, projected splay, or acyclic block graph is assumed. Only literal original physical edges and exact owner-bank stocks are compared.
audit: Reuse only the same four complete original sources. Refute on an exact event immediately, or report finite no-hit without a universal proof. No further weakening is silently substituted.
root_acceptance: OPEN unless initialization, every physical B successor, bounded internal debt, resource sharing and cyclic closure are proved for arbitrary sources.
